subject: Royal Family's Tomb
text: Pulling the second left gravestone facing away from the Royal Family's Tomb reveals a hole where playing the Sun's Song on the steps after killing the Redead reveals a chest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Facing away from the Royal Family's Tomb, pull the second left 
 gravestone to reveal a hole. Drop down, kill the Redead, then play the Sun's
 Song on the steps to reveal a chest with this piece.

subject: Spinning Pot
text: Lighting all torches on the bottom level makes the large pot spin, and throwing a bomb into it from the second level that lands on the happy face releases a Piece of Heart and Rupees.

evidence.quote:
First, light all the torches at the bottom level to make the large
 pot spin. Get on the second level and throw a bomb into the pot. If it lands 
 on the happy face, a Piece of Heart and a lot of Rupees will pop out.

subject: Death Mountain Crater Alcove
text: Stepping slowly off the north wall allows Link to grab the climbable wall and reach an alcove containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Step off the north wall slowly so you'll grab the climbable wall.
 Head into the alcove with the Piece.

subject: Chicken Coop Cage
text: Dropping off the east side of the building where the owl drops Young Link leads onto the chicken coop and through a door to a Piece of Heart inside a cage.

evidence.quote:
Drop off the east side of the
 building, land on top of the chicken coop, and head through the door to 
 acquire this Piece inside a cage.

subject: Business Deku Scrub
text: Planting a bomb in the center of the fence enclosure near the Lake Hylia entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a Business Deku Scrub who sells a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head over to the entrance to Lake Hylia, (marked by a box of high
 and low fences) and plant a bomb in the center of the box to reveal a Secret 
 Cave. Inside is a Business Deku Scrub who sells you this Piece.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: Winning the Bombchu Bowling Alley minigame awards random prizes including a Purple Rupee, Bombs, Bombchus, a Bomb Bag Upgrade, and a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head into the Bombchu Bowling Alley, which is the two-story
 building. In here you have to use Bombchus to make them scurry to the holes. ... Winning gets you a random prize. Among them are: Purple Rupee, Bombs, 
 Bombchus, Bomb Bag Upgrade, and this Piece of Heart.

subject: Isolated Pillar
text: Climbing the ladder and gliding with a Cucco allows Link to reach an isolated pillar holding a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the ladder, then pick
 up the other Cucco at the top. Use it to fly over to a pillar with this Piece
 on it.

subject: Waterfall Ledge
text: Gliding from the top bridge near the waterfall with a Cucco reaches the west ledge with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head all the way to the waterfall with a Cucco in hand, get on the
 top bridge, then glide over to the west ledge with this Piece on it.

subject: Waterfall Torch Chest
text: Using a Deku Stick to light all torches quickly starting from the King's room stairs and ending behind the waterfall reveals a treasure chest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Use a Deku Stick to light the torch at the bottom of the stairs
 from the King's room first, then use this torch as a starting point to light 
 all the other torches quickly. The final two torches are behind the waterfall. 
 If successful, a treasure chest containing this Piece will appear behind the
 waterfall.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Catching a fish of at least 10 lbs at the Fishing Pond and presenting it to the fisherman awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head to the Fishing Pond on the east side of the lake and catch a
 fish of at least 10 lbs. Taking it to the fisherman will get you this Piece.

subject: Cliff Platform Crate
text: Flying down from the cliff with a Cucco to a platform with a crate yields a Piece of Heart inside the crate.

evidence.quote:
Grab the Cucco, then at the cliff, fly down to the platform with a
 crate on it. The crate contains this Piece.

subject: Waterfall Alcove
text: Jumping behind the waterfall at the bottom of the valley leads to a ladder and an alcove containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Jump behind 
 the waterfall and reach the ladder. ... At the top of the 
 ladder is an alcove with this Piece inside.

subject: Graveyard High Ledge
text: Planting a Magic Bean in the graveyard dirt as Young Link allows Adult Link to ride the grown plant to a ledge with a crate holding a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
While Young Link, head into the Graveyard and plant a Magic Bean on
 the plot of dirt. Return as Adult Link and ride the now-grown plant to reach a
 ledge with a crate containing this Piece.

subject: Windmill High Platform
text: Exiting Dampe's race onto the high ledge inside the windmill lets Link ride a rotating ledge to reach a Piece of Heart on a high platform.

evidence.quote:
Finish Dampe's race in the graveyard and you'll end up on a high
 ledge inside the windmill. Use a ledge on the machine to carry you to this
 Piece on a high platform.

subject: Dampe's Race
text: Completing Dampe's race in under a minute rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Finish Dampe's race in under a minute and he'll give you this
 Piece.

subject: Rooftop Man
text: Hookshotting from the windmill entrance fence to the gray-roofed house allows Link to receive a Piece of Heart from the man on the roof.

evidence.quote:
Head up to the entrance of the windmill, hop onto the fence nearby,
 and Hookshot to the house with the gray roof. On top is a man who will give 
 you this Piece for climbing up here.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern Entrance Ledge
text: Planting a Magic Bean at the entrance of Dodongo's Cavern as Young Link allows Adult Link to ride the grown plant to a ledge with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
While Young Link, plant a Magic Bean on the plot of soil right at
 the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern. Return as Adult Link and ride the grown 
 plant to a ledge with this Piece of Heart.

subject: Ice Platform
text: Jumping across the floating pieces of ice where Jabu-Jabu used to reside in Zora's Fountain leads to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
In the fountain, jump across the floating pieces of ice where
 Jabu-Jabu used to be to reach this Piece.

subject: Laboratory Roof
text: Riding the grown Magic Bean plant near the Laboratory lets Link jump onto the roof and climb the ladder to a Piece of Heart at the top.

evidence.quote:
While Young Link, plant a Magic Bean on the plot of dirt near the
 Lab. Return as Adult Link and ride the plant. Jump off onto the roof, then 
 climb the ladder being careful with the Guays, and the Piece of Heart will be 
 at the top.

subject: Lakeside Laboratory Pool
text: Diving down 9 meters into the water with the Golden Scale and speaking to the old man in the Laboratory earns a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Enter the Laboratory, talk to the old man, then dive into the water
 with the Golden Scale. Dive down to 9 meters, then talk to the old man again
 and he should give you this Piece.
